priority_items.title: FBC carries CDD/Lal overlay; Speaker sitting leftover; still no GE-on-time guarantee
priority_items.summary: In-window FBC (17 Sep 13:08 FJT / 01:08 UTC) carries Centre for Democracy and Dialogue warning that a 24 Dec 2026 in-force clock could amount to an autogolpe if electoral-system change makes an on-time GE impossible. National-broadcaster overlay of already-sitting FijiVillage/Fiji Sun CLAIM. Speaker-confirmed 22 Sep 11:30 sitting leftover. fiji.gov.fj still silent on CRC/HIV. Report unpublished. Referendum Bill unpassed. Not extra-constitutional. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: FCOSS seeks civil-society role in Vuvale / Ocean of Peace implementation
priority_items.summary: In-window FBC (17 Sep 13:00 FJT / 01:00 UTC): Fiji Council of Social Services Executive Director Vani Catanasiga submissions to the Standing Committee on Foreign Affairs and Defence on the Vuvale Union and Ocean of Peace Alliance. Asks to monitor treaty implementation and mutual accountability. Parliamentary-committee process on existing architecture, not a new pact. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: Agriculture Super El Niño farmer warning; still not a drought gazette
priority_items.summary: In-window FBC (17 Sep 13:04 FJT / 01:04 UTC): Agriculture Minister Tomasi Tunabuna warns a possible Super El Niño could continue into early next year; crop, livestock and sugarcane-recovery pressure. Complements Funaki/Yasawa/Labasa leftovers. Not an official drought-emergency gazette. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: NBC homepage now leads Saroa civic message; Panguna #2; Goroka off homepage but 9 still at large
priority_items.summary: In-window NBC (17 Sep 11:37 PGT / 01:37 UTC) leads Nelson Saroa Independence civic message. 16 Sep Panguna landowner ceremony drops to #2 (still not a licence). Goroka 17-escape drops off homepage; body still 'Nine remain at large'. In-window Haus Bung recap of 15 Sep Rabaul BNBM robbery; suspects still at large. PMNEC still no 16 Sep transcript. ABG still expired TLS / silent on 16 Sep ceremony. Not FLASH.
